l.i: tici, ex ore D. ZACHARIAE VRSINI, verè
Theologi (qui Heydelbergae Catecheseos explicationem continuare solebat & iterare) diverso tempore ab ipsius discipulis excepti:

main_text.l: Ad septem exemplaria, diligenter inter se collata, pluribus in locis emendati, variis quaestionibus, thesibus, & argumentis auctiores facti, & nunc denuo non parua accessione eorum, quae in commentarijs desiderabantur (quod ex indice facile apparebit) locupletati.

l.i: Gen.18.19. Cùm novērim eum non revelarem? ob hanc causam, ut praecipiat filijs suis, & domesticis suis post se, ut observent viam Jehovae, e:rcendo[?] justitiam & judicium, & ut praestet Jehova Abrahamo.. quod promisit ei.

main_text.l: Ex officina THOMAE THOMASII Inclytae Academiae Cantabrigiensis Typographi.

page.notes: Ornaments: a decorative floral border piece at the top right of "DOCTRINAE", and a symmetrical ornamental tailpiece between the quotation and the imprint; not transcribed. Handwriting (the shelf or ownership marks at upper right, the "d" and "1585" flourish, the tick below the date) is not printed text and is left out. The Gen.18.19 line is printed in italic and copied as set; "novērim" and "revelarem" are given with u/v normalised; "e:rcendo" is printed with a spacing gap and I am not certain of the letters, so it is marked [?]. "Abrahamo.." is printed with a doubled full stop and left as printed. The imprint's "Inclytae" is kept as printed.
